I should never blind-play when a known playable card is available, and a rank signal for a playable card should touch one whose rank is next in its tower. I'm also thinking about holding a signalled card that can't be played yet, and

I'm also weighing whether a misfire blind play is ever worth it, and I'd treat it as a last resort. When every card in hand is unknown, I'd only discard one I can prove is dead, and otherwise fall back on elimination by tallying the unseen cards.
